description:
Navigate to the cancer drug 'Ribociclib' in the Liverpool Cancer iChart app. Look up two co-medications: 'Clarithromycin' and 'Rifampicin'.

Read the interaction details for BOTH.

Create a report file at '/sdcard/ribociclib_risk_analysis.txt' that explicitly states which drug causes 'Increased Toxicity' (or increased exposure) and which causes 'Decreased Efficacy' (or decreased exposure).

Your report format should be similar to:
Drug: Clarithromycin
Risk: [Type]
Drug: Rifampicin
Risk: [Type]
